title: Get Grades
description: Maps a decimal mark to a grade letter.

data.question: Write a program that reads a decimal mark and prints A above 85, B from 70.5 to 85, C from 60 to 70.5, otherwise F.

brief.summary: Maps a decimal mark to a grade letter.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a decimal mark and prints A above 85, B from 70.5 to 85, C from 60 to 70.5, otherwise F.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: A requires a mark strictly above 85, so exactly 85 prints B. The B range includes 70.5 and 85, and C includes 60 through 70.5.
